prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.)
text: This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at a signalized intersection. Our client was struck while proceeding through the intersection and has since received medical treatment for injuries that are still being evaluated. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person. Kindly provide, within the timeframe permitted by applicable law, the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including photographs, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle data, repair estimates, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.
